facts.business: Ebix Limited operates a diversified portfolio across technology-enabled services (InsurTech, FinTech, digital payments, healthcare, travel, e-learning), hospitality, digital marketing, and quick service restaurants (QSR).

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Qualified due to delays in statutory dues deposit, insufficient audit evidence on business rationale of investments/CCPS/inter-corporate deposits, and material related party transactions without prior shareholder approval. Emphasis on acquisition of Ebix Inc via Chapter 11 proceedings with Vikas Lifecare contributing INR 2,977.27 million.

key_risks: Delays in deposit of statutory dues
Uncertain realizability of investments in CCPS based on projected financials
Material related party transactions without prior shareholder approval
Bank account attachments due to arbitral award (partially lifted post-reporting)
Write-off of MAT credit entitlement of ₹2,770.94 million
Ongoing litigation including commercial suit challenging shareholding changes and rights issue
Sub-adjudication matters with NCLT and courts
Loan to Vitasta Software India Private Limited admitted into CIRP
facts.related_party_note: Material related party transactions including inter-corporate deposits, acquisition of investments with subsidiaries/step-down subsidiaries/associates entered during FY2025-26 without prior shareholder approval as required under Regulation 23 SEBI LODR and Section 188 Companies Act; company in process of obtaining approvals.
